title: cpu benchmarking
overview: ml-based CPU performance optimisation comparing XGBoost, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression.
problem: predicting cpu performance under different workloads usually means slow, expensive real-world benchmarking.
built: an ml pipeline comparing xgboost, random forest, and logistic regression models trained on performance data, aiming to predict outcomes without running the full benchmark suite.
learned: how much model choice depends on the shape of your data — xgboost's edge here wasn't automatic, and i had to actually justify it with the numbers, not just pick the trendy model.
